one_line: Open on the cover, then the child's reaction; the moment she points at herself is the proof.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static top-down cover on a white bed: an illustrated toddler with raised fists before landmarks. 0:01 subtitle: "לא הייתי מוכנה לתגובה של" (the child's name) "לזה." 0:02 a real toddler holds the book, a hand reaches in.
q1_hook.why: "I was not ready for her reaction" opens a gap that a laugh pays within 5 s (H5), over a book on screen at 0:00 (S1) and a child's face from 0:02 (H4, K8). The first frame has no text and no face; the first subtitle lands at 0:01 (T3, H1).

beats.what: Static cover on a bed; a real toddler enters, a hand reaching in; the subtitle starts at 0:01
beats.why: A gap about her reaction, with the product shown

beats.what: The toddler tips over laughing, presses her face to the book; "קיבלנו את הספר שלה Mebook"
beats.why: The first reaction, answering the opening

beats.what: She lies on her back holding the book up, smiling to the lens; "בואו איתנו למסע מסביב לעולם."
She leafs through; a football scene beside landmarks; "התחלנו בברצלונה ומשם המשכנו לפריז"
beats.why: Pages and places, a new picture each shot

beats.what: She taps the illustrated girl in a Paris scene; "ולא הפסיקה להצביע על עצמה", "הנה אני."
Last pages; the printed thank-you page with a code and a discount line; "הופה.", sticker poppers
Back cover; she kisses it; "תודה.", "ותודה Mebook על המסע הקסום"; a black frame at 0:50
beats.why: A warm close that asks for nothing

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, tip or ask to comment, share or save in the video; the caption is four words.
q2_flow.why: The opening gap is answered by a laugh within 5 s, and again at 0:26 to 0:29 when she points at herself (H5, K2). A new angle every 3 to 6 s keeps it moving (R3). The last 9 s hold on thanks with little new, long for the message (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: None said or written by the creator, in the video or the caption. The printed thank-you page, 0:33 to 0:41, carries a code and a discount line that is never read out. Last subtitle: "ותודה Mebook על המסע הקסום".
q3_cta.why: No ask, so it stays a pure reaction clip. The one commerce cue, a code on a tilted printed page for 8 s, is unspoken and hard to read, so a viewer moved at 0:28 gets no clear next step (C6).

q4_shown.what: The cover with an illustrated toddler, 0:00-0:02; a real toddler of about 1 to 2 holding it, laughing, pressing her face to it; page flips of landmarks and a football scene; her tapping the illustrated girl, 0:22-0:29; the printed thank-you page with a code, 0:33-0:41.
q4_shown.why: Her tapping the illustrated girl while the voice says "הנה אני" is the self-recognition parents want to see (S8, K8). The cover character and the toddler both wear two hair buns, but they never sit steady side by side (S2). The parent's first-hand voice vouches (S6). A toddler's face with her name goes against S5.

q5_edit.what: 13 shots in 50.5 s, about 3.9 s each; hard cuts between mostly continuous handheld takes, no speed changes seen. One- or two-line subtitles with purple key words and emoji stickers (globes, poppers, bells, praying hands). Ends on a black frame at 0:50.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 1.8 s and a new angle every 3 to 6 s is a moderate pace (E1, E2). Subtitles follow the voice (E4). Stickers add noise (T2). The last 9 s add only thanks (R1, E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother shows her toddler's first meeting with a personalised world-tour book: laughing, kissing it, pointing at the illustrated girl. It serves parents wanting a gift a child will love.
q6_topic.why: A toddler's laughter and recognition is a high-arousal positive moment (K1, K8), framed as a small story, the reaction she was not ready for (K2). The claim is only that she is the main character, a modest one (K4). No occasion or buyer is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld high-angle and top-down shots of a toddler on a white bed beside a braided bumper, in soft daylight; a hand enters at 0:02; face close-ups; a tilted top-down close-up of the printed page. A pink "Mebook.ai" label sits near the bottom of every frame.
q7_filmed.why: A real bed, soft light and a real toddler look native and sharp (H8, F7). Top-down views put the viewer at the pages (F5). The tilted page makes the code hard to read (F4). A brand label in every frame is the plastered brand the rules warn against (H3, C7).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a dark outline, 1 to 2 lines, centred about 58% down, key words in purple: "לא הייתי מוכנה לתגובה של" (0:01), "קיבלנו את הספר שלה Mebook" (0:04), "הדמות הראשית." (0:09), "בואו איתנו למסע מסביב לעולם." (0:11), "התחלנו בברצלונה ומשם המשכנו לפריז וגם" (0:14), "הנה אני." (0:28), "הופה." (0:35), "ותודה Mebook על המסע הקסום" (0:47). A pink "Mebook.ai" label at the bottom of every frame.
q8_text.caption: "מסע מסביב לעולם. 🌍🥹". Four words and two emojis. No brand tag, no hashtags, no code, no question, no disclosure word.
q8_text.why: Subtitles carry the voice, so it works muted (T1), and sit mid-frame, clear of the bottom 35% (T4), but purple highlights and stickers add noise (T2), and no headline card names the topic (T3). The caption has no product words or hashtags (T7). The label is a brand mark, not a disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: A pink brand label in every frame; no CTA, price or how-to-order; the code only on a tilted printed page; 9 s of thanks at the end; busy stickers; a toddler's face with her name; no disclosure word.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the cover on a bed, then top-down hands turning to a page with the name; say one moment of recognition and add the offer on screen.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's; music; the exact wording of the discount line on the printed page (partly readable). The child's name is in the subtitles and the transcript, not quoted. Correction to coded file: the burned-in subtitle at 0:17 to 0:18 skips the third city that the transcript mishears, so the city is unread. The black frame at 0:50 is confirmed.
